description:
The DotNetBrowser agent skill for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot: rules, the API reference, and an offline copy of the DotNetBrowser documentation for the same version as this package.

The package adds no assemblies to your application. Set DotNetBrowserAgentSkillsAgent or DotNetBrowserAgentSkillsDirectory to install the skill into your agent's skills directory on build, or run the InstallDotNetBrowserAgentSkills target.
